instruction: Merge all .txt files from your vscode project into "unified.docx" on Desktop with LibreOffice Writer. Set the text color of the first paragraph to blue (#0000FF) and font size to 11.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.getWindowsWithTitle('unified.docx'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(1)

metadata.explanation: Task requires merging 5 txt files into a docx, setting first paragraph text color to blue (#0000FF), and font size to 11. Evaluator checks exact color match and font size. Since instruction specifies exact hex code #0000FF, strict color matching is appropriate.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three requirements: (1) merged content via character count check, (2) first paragraph color is blue, (3) first paragraph font size is 11
Getter properly checks all runs in first paragraph via 'all_colors_match' flag, ensuring entire first paragraph has the correct color, not just the first run
Metric awards partial credit appropriately: 30% for color, 30% for font size, 40% for content merging
Postconfig appropriately saves the document before verification
Minor weakness: min_char_count=100 is a weak proxy for verifying ALL .txt files were merged - could pass with partial merging if content exceeds 100 chars
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding metadata explaining why min_char_count=100 is the correct threshold (e.g., 'total characters from all 5 txt files = X, using 100 as minimum threshold')
For stronger verification, could check for specific text snippets from each .txt file or calculate exact expected character count from source files
